/**
 * GET /admin/accessories/{accessory_id}.json
 *
 * Examples:
 *
 *      insales.getAccessory({
 *        token: '1234567890',
 *        url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru',
 *        accessoryid: '44'
 *      }).then(response => {
 *        console.info(response.data);
 *      }).catch(err => {
 *        console.error(err);
 *      });
 * Output:
 *
 *      {
 *        "id": 44,
 *        "account_id": 1,
 *        "name_translations": [
 *          "Интеллектуальный Резиновый Нож"
 *        ],
 *        "min_count": 4,
 *        "max_count": 6,
 *        "created_at": "2026-10-21T23:15:57.058+03:00",
 *        "updated_at": "2026-10-21T23:15:57.058+03:00",
 *        "back_office_name": "Интеллектуальный Пластиковый Часы",
 *        "permalink": "eum_perferendis",
 *        "name": "Интеллектуальный Резиновый Нож"
 *      }
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.token Required, access token for shop
 * @param {string} options.url Required, shop url
 * @param {number|string} options.accessoryid Required, accessory id
 * @param {Number|String} id Required, app id
 * @returns {Promise}
 */
export function getAccessory(options, id) {
  return get({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `accessories/${options.accessoryid}`
  });
}

export function getClient(options, id) {

export function listClient(options, id) {
  const query = {};
  if (options.updated_since) {

  }
  if (options.from_id) {
    query.from_id = options.from_id;
  }
  if (options.per_page) {

  if (options.q) {

  if (options.phone) {

  if (options.email) {

  if (options.registered) {

  return get({

    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `clients`,

 * @returns {Promise}
 */
export function getDeliveryVariant(options, id) {
  return get({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `delivery_variants/${options.deliveryvariantid}`
  });
}

export function listOrder(options, id) {
  const query = {};
  if (options.fulfillment_status) {
    query.fulfillment_status = options.fulfillment_status;
  }
  if (options.delivery_variant) {
    query.delivery_variant = options.delivery_variant;
  }
  if (options.payment_gateway_id) {
    query.payment_gateway_id = options.payment_gateway_id;
  }
  if (options.updated_since) {
    query.updated_since = options.updated_since;
  }
  if (options.from_id) {
    query.from_id = options.from_id;
  }
  if (options.per_page) {
    query.per_page = options.per_page;
  }
  if (options.page) {
    query.page = options.page;
  }
  return get({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `orders`,
    query
  });
}

/**
 * GET /admin/properties/{property_id}.json
 *
 * Examples:
 *
 *      insales.getProperty({
 *        token: '1234567890',
 *        url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru',
 *        propertyid: '1'
 *      }).then(response => {
 *        console.info(response.data);
 *      }).catch(err => {
 *        console.error(err);
 *      });
 * Output:
 *
 *      {
 *        "id": 1,
 *        "position": 8,
 *        "backoffice": false,
 *        "is_hidden": false,
 *        "is_navigational": true,
 *        "permalink": "producer",
 *        "title": "Producer"
 *      }
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.token Required, access token for shop
 * @param {string} options.url Required, shop url
 * @param {number|string} options.propertyid Required, property id
 * @param {Number|String} id Required, app id
 * @returns {Promise}
 */
export function getProperty(options, id) {
  return get({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `properties/${options.propertyid}`
  });
}

 * @param {string} options.lang Required, locale, for example ru

export function listUnit(options, id) {

    url: options.url,
    api: `units`,
    query
  });
}

 *        "price2": 12,
 *        "price": "150.0",
 *        "base_price_in_site_currency": "4500.0",
 *        "old_price_in_site_currency": null,
 *        "price2_in_site_currency": "360.0",
 *        "prices": [
 *          12
 *        ],
 *        "prices_in_site_currency": [
 *          "360.0"
 *        ],
 *        "variant_field_values": [
 *          {
 *            "id": 1,
 *            "variant_field_id": 1,
 *            "value": "12345"
 *          }
 *        ],
 *        "option_values": [
 *          {
 *            "id": 1,
 *            "option_name_id": 1,
 *            "position": 1,
 *            "title": "Red",
 *            "image_url": null,
 *            "permalink": null
 *          }
 *        ]
 *      }
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.token Required, access token for shop
 * @param {string} options.url Required, shop url
 * @param {number|string} options.productid Required, product id
 * @param {number|string} options.variantid Required, variant id
 * @param {object} options.variant Required, variant
 * @param {Number|String} id Required, app id
 * @returns {Promise}
 */
export function editVariant(options, id) {
  return put({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `products/${options.productid}/variants/${options.variantid}`,
    obj: options.variant
  });
}

/**

 *      []
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.token Required, access token for shop
 * @param {string} options.url Required, shop url
 * @param {object} options.variants Required, variants group
 * @param {Number|String} id Required, app id
 * @returns {Promise}
 */
export function editVariantGroup(options, id) {
  return put({
    id,
    token: options.token,
    url: options.url,
    api: `products/variants_group_update`,
    obj: options.variants
  });
}

============
[![Build Status](https://api.travis-ci.org/pomeo/node-insales.png)](http://travis-ci.org/pomeo/node-insales)
[![Coverage Status](https://img.shields.io/coveralls/pomeo/node-insales.svg)](https://coveralls.io/r/pomeo/node-insales)
[![Dependencies](https://david-dm.org/pomeo/node-insales.png)](https://david-dm.org/pomeo/node-insales)
[![NPM version](https://badge.fury.io/js/insales.svg)](http://badge.fury.io/js/insales)
[![ESDoc](https://pomeo.github.io/node-insales/badge.svg)](https://pomeo.github.io/node-insales)

InSales module that allows you to communicate with the [InSales API](http://api.insales.ru) from node.js

## Installation

```
npm install insales --save
```

## Usage

```js
// Import a module
import InSales from 'insales';
// Create an instance with your API credentials
const insales = InSales({
  id: 'your app id',
  secret: 'your app secret'
});

// Get things done
insales.getAccount({
  token: 'token for shop',
  url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru'
}).then(output => {
  console.info(output.data);
}).catch(err => {
  console.error(err);
});
```

## API limits

```js
insales.getAccount({
  token: 'token for shop',
  url: 'shop-test.myinsales.ru'
}).then(output => {
  console.info(output.callLimits); //  { remaining: 498, current: 2, max: 500 } }
})
```
